professionalSummary: Platform Engineer with three years of ownership over a credit workflow system’s Kubernetes runtime platform, responsible for end‑to‑end platform management, production configuration changes, and ensuring high availability.
experienceHighlights: Owned the runtime platform, making and executing production configuration changes to Kubernetes clusters; change records bear candidate’s approval and execution.
Built and maintained infrastructure code using Terraform and Helm, and developed deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging, and production environments.
Led the weekly platform change review, deciding on application and platform changes for the production window and recording decisions in the change‑review log.
Coordinated changes with the application team and security, clearly delineating ownership of application configuration, security policy baseline, cluster configuration, and production window.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Platform ownership entry in the engineering service catalogue and one month of change records showing approval and execution under the candidate’s user ID, with change tool identifiers as a verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample evidence establish the candidate’s ownership, configuration change execution, infrastructure code and pipeline maintenance, weekly change review leadership, and coordination with application and security teams. The evidence does not cover runbook documentation, known limitations, or hand‑over conditions for each platform change.

evidence.text: Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former head of platform engineering: confirmed the candidate was the platform's named owner, decided and executed production changes and led the change review; confirmed employment dates.
Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.
evidence.notes: Direct claim of code and pipeline maintenance.

evidence.text: Led the weekly platform change review, deciding which application and platform changes were scheduled into the production window and recording the decisions in the change-review log.
evidence.notes: Direct claim of leadership and record keeping.

evidence.text: Coordinated changes with the application team and security, recording that the application team owned application configuration and security owned the policy baseline while I owned the cluster configuration and the production window.
